characterList.description: White male, mid 20s, light brown hair, wearing a black coat over a dark blue vest and a blue tie with white stripes. He holds a digital recorder.
characterList.name: Interviewer

characterList.description: Woman with long black hair, wearing a grey sweatshirt and sunglasses.
characterList.name: Teesha Stout

characterList.description: Woman with black hair, wearing a green sweater, appears briefly in the last section of the video.
characterList.name: Harley

content_metadata.description: An emotional interview with Teesha Stout discussing her experiences during the investigation of her stepson Gannon Stauch's disappearance.

qAndA.answer: Teesha mentions that Gannon loves Sonic and Mario games.
qAndA.question: What are some examples of video games that Gannon enjoys playing?

qAndA.answer: Teesha doesn't provide specific details, but implies it happened during a search of their home by law enforcement. They were held at gunpoint while officers searched for Gannon.
qAndA.question: What incident led to Teesha and her daughter being held at gunpoint?

qAndA.answer: Teesha explains that she and her daughter had to go to a store to purchase clothes because all their belongings were in their home, which was inaccessible due to the investigation. Law enforcement handcuffed her daughter while she was shopping.
qAndA.question: Why was Teesha's daughter put in handcuffs at a store?

qAndA.answer: Teesha mentions accusations of her disappearance and lack of help in the search for Gannon. She also references conspiracy theories that suggest she harmed Gannon.
qAndA.question: What false accusations have been circulating online about Teesha?

qAndA.answer: The interview takes place in an empty lot with newly constructed houses in the background. This setting creates a sense of emptiness and isolation, reflecting the loss of Gannon and the family's emotional state. The distant mountains and overcast sky further contribute to the somber and uncertain atmosphere.
qAndA.question: How does the scene's setting contribute to the overall mood?

activities.description: Interviewer asks questions, Teesha Stout answers, Harley briefly confirms Gannon was at home

characterInteraction.description: Engage in a professional yet emotionally charged interview.
Harley briefly interacts with the Interviewer, confirming Gannon's presence at home.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene's setting in an empty lot with houses in the background creates a sense of isolation and loss, reflecting the disappearance of Gannon. Teesha Stout's subdued tone and body language contribute to the somber mood.

narrativeProgression.description: Teesha confirms she was the last person to see Gannon.
Teesha states she cannot discuss details of the case.
Teesha mentions false accusations of her disappearance and lack of help.
Death threats against Teesha and her family are revealed.
Teesha feels unfairly labeled as uncooperative with the investigation.
Teesha describes being denied legal representation during an interview.
Teesha alleges being held by police and denied basic rights.
Interviewer acknowledges the feeling of online rumors becoming a 'witch hunt.'
Teesha reveals her family has been avoiding public attention due to online accusations.
Teesha denies accusations of harm towards Gannon and emphasizes her role in his care.
Teesha describes an incident where she and her daughter were held at gunpoint by law enforcement.
Teesha recounts her daughter being put in handcuffs at a store while purchasing clothes due to their own belongings being inaccessible.
Teesha expresses frustration with online conspiracy theories surrounding Gannon's disappearance.
Teesha describes Gannon's kind and helpful personality.
Teesha attempts to involve her daughter in the interview to verify Gannon's presence at home, but reconsiders due to the sensitive nature of the situation.
Harley, Teesha's daughter, briefly appears to confirm Gannon was at home after the hike.
Teesha expresses frustration with online speculation and the impact on her professional reputation.

scenes.thematicElements: Impact of online speculation on families dealing with missing persons cases. Difficulty of navigating law enforcement investigations while under public scrutiny. Importance of community support and faith during difficult times.
scenes.title: Interview with Teesha Stout

videoEditingDetails.description: A silver car drives by on the road behind the subjects.
A white SUV drives by on the road behind the subjects.
The Interviewer steps away to adjust equipment, focusing on Teesha Stout looking off-camera.
A white pickup truck drives by on the road behind the subjects.

climax.description: The emotional peak of the scene is when Teesha describes the incident of being held at gunpoint and her daughter being handcuffed, highlighting the extreme measures taken by law enforcement and the traumatic impact on their family.

storylines.description: Teesha's experience during the Gannon Stauch investigation
